notes.title: Castle Warriors Road Map #1
notes.content:
Hello Warriors!

We have a lot of exciting things to talk about for the future of Castle Warriors. We are hoping to add a lot with our end of year patch and wanted to give you guys an idea of what to expect.  As you guys know we are a small two-man team but we have both recently taken on the challenge of being full time on this project for the remainder of the year. Our goal is to make this next patch something truly special. The major thing is we have been delaying system rewrites for a while now but we are finally committing to them. What that means is we wont be able to patch the game while we do these rewrites. However, there are lots of major things coming with this patch. Here is what we have planned currently:

Patch 0.6 Goal - Mid November

- Overall system rewrites that will solve all lag issues. Combat Flow as well as unit pathing will be seeing massive changes. With these change we are hoping to increase the gameplay speed and number of units on screen dramatically.
- Massive unit balance overhaul to all units via new abilities and attacks
- In game Tooltips for everything. Unit stats, ability details, upgrade details, warrior details, etc. 
- Endless Mode - Featuring a new game format and new enemies!
- Map 7 - Featuring a new faction of enemies!
- +6 Maps adding a new Difficulty Modifier
- 1 New Player Faction
- 1 New Warrior
- New Unit Sprites for all Player Factions

This is a big patch for us because we are hoping it will be closer to what we envisioned when we first started this journey. We are commited to making this next patch the biggest and best patch Castle Warriors has seen yet. While we are behind the scenes working on this patch we do plan to release DevLogs to keep you guys up to date on our progress. 

Thank you for all of your support so far this year! Hopefully, we end the year with a bang :slight_smile:

notes.title: Major Patch 3 Update
notes.content:
Hello Warriors,

As we are approaching the release of patch 0.4 we wanted to update you guys on what features and changes to expect in this patch. We are still about 2 weeks away from the patch dropping but you will be playing the patch this month! There are a few key things we wanted to go over with this patch as there are quite a few big changes to the game.

First things first, WE WILL BE WIPING SAVED DATA WITH THIS PATCH. We do not do this lightly and were trying to avoid this but we think its best for a lot of reasons. The early game is getting a massive overhaul on how you unlock units, warriors, and things like towers. Instead of unlocking units or warriors with gold they are now unlocked via achievements. In our previous versions it would take 10+ hours of gameplay to fully unlock all the units. This process has been streamlined down to a few hours max now. When you clear the 6 maps on their base difficulty you will have unlocked the full unit roster now. These system rewrites have made it very difficult for some save files to transition to the new patch without lots of bugs and errors.

The second reason for the wipe is the new talent system. The Talent system has been set up in a way that when you clear a map for the first time you get +1 talent point. With how we set up this system it was also interacting poorly with our old saves. Players who had cleared most of the maps or partial clears were going to be forced to go back and individually clear maps they already cleared to reclaim those talent points. As with the above system changes this was also leading to frustrating gameplay experiences with the new patch.

Addressing all the problems with save data and the current patch would have caused far too many delays. Add on the fact that we really want you guys to test out the new early game systems, a wipe seems like the best option for us. We aren't happy about this and will be doing everything we can to avoid save wipes in the future. The new early game is way smoother to get through now though, and we hope you won't find it as tedious as your first play through.

With that out of the way here is what to expect from this patch!

Talents - Clear a map for the first time and get +1 talent point with currently 36 talent points total in the game. These talents can be placed into Offensive, Defensive, or Utility trees. You are able to reset your talents at any time to try out multiple builds and styles. As we add more maps and difficulty levels the total amount of talent points in the game will increase over time.

Early Game Overhaul - Unlocking Units is now done by clearing maps. You will unlock the first half of a faction by surviving 10 minutes on a map and the second half of the faction by clearing the map. By the time you have cleared all 6 base maps you will have access to the full 50 unit roster and a handful of warriors. Once map 6 has been cleared you will gain access to Artifacts and Difficulty scaling.

Artifact rework - Artifacts have gotten major changes in this patch. We have fully removed the generic artifacts that buff all units by a percentage. We have added faction based artifacts and warrior artifacts that drastically change how the warrior ability works. We have also reworked both the dwarf and elf warrior abilities so make sure the check them out!

Patch will also feature a change to map sizes, +5 difficulty maps, and some unit balance changes.

We greatly appreciate all the support you guys have given us over the last several months. The game has seriously changed quite a bit since launch and its because of your feedback. Please continue giving us your feedback, bug reports, and support because it's fueling us hard! Drop a steam review if you haven't as its the best way to support us currently! We will have the exact date for the release of this patch soon but expect it before the end of the month for sure!

notes.title: Major Patch 1
notes.content:
Hey Warriors! 

We would like to start our first Major Patch notes by saying thank you to everyone! All of your screenshots, bug reports, balance feedback, and general discussion both on the Steam Forums and in our Discord means a lot to both of us. Another big thank you to the content creators we've seen put out Castle Warriors videos and streams! 

This first Major Patch is our tightest window with only around two weeks of development time, but every following Major Patch has a full month scheduled. We're looking forward to the next few months of Early Access and hope to hear more from you all!
